summary: Guangdong Hongjing Optoelectronic Technology Inc. is a company dedicated to the complete lifecycle of advanced optical lenses and camera modules, from their initial research and conceptualization through design, development, production, and global sales. The company's diverse product portfolio primarily serves the smart vehicle and evolving consumer electronics industries. For the automotive sector, they supply a variety of lens and module solutions, including systems for rearview cameras, panoramic surround-view, front-facing perception, electronic rearview mirrors, and in-cabin monitoring. In the consumer market, their offerings extend to components for cutting-edge technologies such as VR/AR full-view cameras, smart home devices, wearable cameras, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), scanning applications, and Time-of-Flight (TOF) systems. Additionally, Guangdong Hongjing provides integrated optical imaging solutions. Founded in 2012, the company is headquartered in Zhongshan, China.
